description: Statelessly render a 144-PPI PNG preview of a document as a Base64 data URI without mutating server records. Example: preview_document({"doc_type":"invoice","from":{"name":"Acme"},"to":{"name":"Client"}})

county.description: County name for notarial jurat and recording cover header (e.g., 'Hamilton').

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code or symbol (default 'USD'; supports EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, JPY, CHF).

currency_placement.description: Place currency symbol/code before or after amounts.

currency_symbol_mode.description: Display currency symbol ('$') or ISO code ('USD').

discount_amount.description: Flat document-level discount subtracted before grand total.

doc_number.description: Unique document identifier (e.g., 'INV-2026-0042'); auto-generated when omitted.

doc_type.description: Document archetype across 57 commercial, legal, and real estate templates (e.g., invoice, residential_lease).

from.description: Issuer, seller, landlord, or service provider details.

tax_id.description: Issuer EIN, VAT, or tax ID.

include_clerk_stamp.description: Reserves a County Clerk recording stamp zone on wet-ink jurats.

is_paid.description: Marks the document PAID IN FULL.

items.description: Billable line items, milestones, rent schedules, or fee breakdowns.

quantity.description: Quantity of units, hours, or months.

unit_price.description: Unit rate or price per item.

lease_package_mode.description: Appends mandatory state statutory attachment sheets and move-in checklist.

municipality.description: Municipal sub-profile ('Chicago', 'Cook County', 'New York City', 'San Francisco', 'Seattle', 'Portland').

notary_required.description: Renders a state-specific Notarial Acknowledgment and Jurat block.

payment_link.description: HTTPS checkout URL embedded as a link and vector QR code.

payment_qr_code.description: Embeds a vector SVG QR code when payment_link is provided.

recordable.description: Applies County Recorder 3-inch top margin header and official stamp reserve.

sections.description: Structured legal clauses or terms sections.

state_code.description: 2-letter US state or DC code (e.g., 'TN', 'CA', 'NY') for 50-state statutory clauses.

tax_rate.description: Percentage tax rate applied to subtotal (e.g., 8.25).

terms.description: Payment terms, late fee policy, or legal clauses.

theme.description: Visual typography and color theme preset.

to.description: Recipient, buyer, client, or tenant details.

year_built.description: Property construction year (< 1978 triggers Federal Lead-Based Paint disclosure).

name: preview_document
title: Preview Document as PNG
